author: willai3213
title: Seeking designer for exhibition character visuals
content: [徵｜展覽平面設計專案合作] Recently preparing an exhibition at Huashan, Taipei in early December. Looking for a graphic designer for main visual, wordmark, character visuals (6 designs, not too complex), character standees, window stickers, flags, and other exhibition derivatives. Timeline Oct-Dec 2026. Prefer hand-drawn / Japanese / warm style. Comment or DM with portfolio + quote.
